launcher.title: Quick Launch
launcher.subtitle: Curate a clickable list — apps, files, shortcuts, websites or commands — and open any of them in one click. Check items off, reorder, add or remove.
launcher.empty: Nothing here yet. Click "Add" to add an app, website or command you want to open in one click.
launcher.done.tip: Mark as done (does not affect opening)
launcher.dup.title: Duplicate item
launcher.dup.body: A Quick Launch item that opens the same thing already exists: "{0}" (same type and target). Duplicates aren't allowed.
widget.empty: The list is empty. Add items on the Quick Launch page.
launcher.delete.title: Delete item
launcher.clearDone.title: Clear done
launcher.edit.name: Name
launcher.edit.needTarget: Please enter a target (path, URL or command).
launcher.edit.hint.app: Full path to an application, file or shortcut (.lnk). Environment variables like %USERPROFILE% are supported.
launcher.edit.hint.url: A web address, e.g. https://github.com (the https:// may be omitted).
launcher.edit.hint.command: A command line run through cmd.exe /c.
